page.layout: One block of running text in the upper left, a single column of verse-like prose; a blank area below; a signature mark "AD" at the lower right foot.

main_text.p: magis, quàm ambitione vin- cendi; nam Aquila tua, quæ sibi Germanicam, Hispani- camque associauit, non vnum dabit fulmen, quo dimicet; non exiguam coronam, qua triumphet; non tenues alas, quàrum ope feratur ad gloriā. Deniq; dabit nomen Valerium: quid plura? cedite campum, laurum, triumphum. Victo- ria meæ Palladis est.

page.notes: Lower part of the page is blank apart from stains and specks. The first line of the scan begins mid-sentence ("magis, quàm"), so the text is a fragment carried over from the previous page. Some words at the line ends are hard to read because of the scan; "associauit" and "Germanicam" are read with some doubt. The mark "AD" at the foot is a gathering signature, not text. No page number or running head is printed.
